description: This file defines the IGrainBase interface and related extension methods for grain lifecycle management and timer creation in the Orleans framework. It also includes the DeactivationReasonCode enum used for deactivation reasons.

classes.name: GrainBaseExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IGrainBase, including timer registration and lifecycle management.

classes.name: DeactivationReasonCode
classes.description: Enum representing various reasons for grain deactivation.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Method to handle grain activation, can be overridden by implementations.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Method to handle grain deactivation, can be overridden by implementations.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdle
methods.description: Extension method to deactivate the grain after current method completes.

methods.name: MigrateOnIdle
methods.description: Extension method to initiate migration of the grain to another location.

methods.name: RegisterGrainTimer
methods.description: Multiple overloads to create and register grain timers with various callback signatures and options.
